title.narrative: Empowering Caritas Marsabit: Advancing Institutional Capacity for Sustainable Growth and Impact.

description.narrative: Our Common Home (v.2) commits all of CAFOD to the goal of supporting partners to secure the sustainable funding, organisational capacities and operational space they need to lead initiatives that meet the needs of their communities (OCH Goal 2). CAFOD and Caritas Marsabit are in the process of signing a Bespoke partnership agreement of which CAFOD will be supporting the partner to strengthen its capacity to be able to access direct funding locally and from institutional donors. In the pilot phase CAFOD commits £10,000 to Caritas Marsabit to strengthen the capacity of Caritas Marsabit in the following areas. -Support Capacity strengthening of Caritas Marsabit Board member on Governance -Organization staff capacity building on Budgeting and Financial Planning -Support Integrated Program Management System -Training on Data Management and Communication -Support development of Caritas Marsabit Resource Mobilization Strategy. -Staff training on resource mobilization. this is a timebound project for 1 year effective from 1st April 2025 to 31st March 2026
